venues.name: BLINK Roppongi (BLINK 六本木)
venues.note: Bilingual JA/EN staff and a fully bilingual booking site. 1F cafe lounge is rented as an event space (events, seminars, workshops, filming), open to non-members, with on-site coffee bar — perfect coffee/hack-day vibe. Hosts 200+ events/year; easy EN email flow via contact form.

venues.note: Purpose-built conference floor directly connected to Roppongi-itchome Station west gate, with dedicated elevator for private-floor events. Publishes hourly rates, seat layouts, 360° tour. EN-facing 'For overseas corporations' note: inquiries by email, English OK on email; venue staff JP-only so budget an interpreter.

venues.note: Standalone event hall on the green Izumi Garden grounds, 3 min walk from Roppongi-itchome. 6 m ceilings, 5x 250-inch screens, dedicated line — proven for embassy + global tech events (IPEF launch, Nijisanji live viewings). Same Sumitomo Bellesalle team; EN via email, JP-only on-site.

venues.note: Independent live/event space 4 min from Azabu-Juban, 8 min from Akabanebashi — short hop from Roppongi. Pro audio/lighting, 6.6 m stage, onsite kitchen and bar; ok on the smaller end for a 50–100-person casual coffee/hack day. JP-primary site — partner with a JP speaker to book.

closures: The Hive Jinnan (1-6-5 Jinnan, Shibuya) — own domain https://thehivejinnan.com/ failed to fetch this session, ray-terrace.co.jp (Aug 2022) marks it【閉店】, and spacebase lists the event listing as 'Unfortunately, this venue is no longer available'. Conflicting breadcrumbs: thehive.com/all-locations still shows Jinnan and 2026 blog listicles (japan-dev, modernlivingjapan) still recommend it. Treated as closed/unverifiable and excluded from the venue list.

Plug and Play Shibuya (渋谷道玄坂東急ビル) — original coworking space CLOSED. Per the press release (Dec 2024) and 3rd-party directories, Plug and Play Japan rebranded/relaunched the space in March 2025 as a members-only innovation hub restricted to PnP partners, portfolio startups, and registered mentors. No longer bookable by external event organizers, so excluded from the venue list.

Creative Lounge MOV (渋谷ヒカリエ8F) — included as 'rejected for primary list': although MOV is a strong coworking space, its only rentable event area is the small aiiima showcase (~20-30 people) and member-only Open Lounge. No 50-200 person event space available. The 8/ COURT event space on the same floor (separate operator) is the correct bookable option and is listed.

Shibuya Stream Hall (渋谷ストリームホール) — excluded: although a proper event hall (theater 270 / standing 500), it is positioned as a live-music concert venue and priced accordingly; no coworking context and not a fit for a daytime tech-week coffee/hack day.

Shibuya Hikarie Hall (ヒカリエホール 9F) — excluded: 864-person theatre-scale hall, oversized and formal for the stated 50-200 coffee/hack-day format. Hikarie 8/COURT (smaller, more casual) is listed instead.

WIRED CAFE NEWS 日本橋三井タワー店 (Nihonbashi Mitsui Tower 2F) — closed; Tabelog lists it as currently closed (閉店) and PartyLabel page is under /close/ stating '当店は閉店致しました'. Cafe Company's 2026 brand list no longer includes this branch.

WeWork 日本生命日本橋ビル (日本橋2-13-12): rejected as public venue for a 50-200 event. Their Japanese member base uses internal lounges; no public event-space rental listing could be verified on wework.co.jp for this location, so it fails the 'dedicated events page or published events contact' bar. Not a closure, just not bookable for this purpose.
Tokyo Innovation Base (TIB, 有楽町): outside the requested Nihonbashi/Kayabacho neighborhood (it's in Yurakucho, Chiyoda), so excluded despite being a strong 2026 venue.
xBridge-Kyobashi: not closed, but kept as 'alt' under xBridge-Yaesu (京橋3-6-18) — slightly outside the strict Kayabacho/Nihonbashi core, while still inside Chūō ward.
HARIO CAFE (Roppongi) — dropped: site fetch failed and venue is a small specialty-coffee counter well below the 50-200 person brief, so not suitable for this tech-week coffee/hack day.
512 CAFE & GRILL (Akasaka 9-chome, Roppongi edge) — dropped: only ~20-30 person buyout (店内20名/テラス込み30名), below the 50-person floor of the brief.

CIC Tokyo Venture Café (Toranomon Hills 15F) — dropped: outstanding fit for a 60-120 person bilingual tech coffee day with strong English support, but the venue is in Toranomon, not Roppongi, so outside the neighbourhood scope.
Roppongi Hills Club (banquet floors) — dropped: members' club banquets (up to 250 buffet) sit in the same complex as venue #1 but are not a café-type space.

Blink Smart Workspace (Roppongi, Motoazabu 3-1-6) — dropped: coworking café with events on request, but its regular social events top out around ~60 people and no dedicated published rental page with capacity for 50-200 could be confirmed this session.
クロスオフィス六本木 (Cross Office Roppongi) — closed 2026-03-31 per official site https://www.crossoffice.jp/office/roppongi

NewsPicks Roppongi (TRI-SEVEN ROPPONGI 3F, max 300) — exists but no public rental booking path found; space is reserved for Uzabase/NewsPicks in-house and sponsor events. Skipped rather than listed with an unverified link.
WeWork Ark Hills South (Roppongi 1-4-5) — coworking only; public event-space rental not offered for non-members. Skipped.
SENQ六本木 — members-only coworking; no public 50-200-person event-rental program. Skipped.
SPACES六本木 / Regus Roppongi — meeting rooms only, no 50+ event hall. Skipped.
neighborhood_analysis: Shibuya is Tokyo's proven bilingual tech hub (Builders Weekend 2026, ai& × Moonshot, Tokyo Tech Meetup) with the densest event-capable cafes; Nihonbashi/Kayabacho and Roppongi are strong enterprise/startup backups. Akihabara/Odaiba follow-up needed for the 200-cap conference inventory.
